artifacts.summary: Audit of the Typst <leader>l command group: confirms duplicated/disagreeing main-file and project-root detection across after/ftplugin/typst.lua, lua/neotex/plugins/text/typst-preview.lua, and tinymist's LSP root_markers; identifies two concrete unreliability mechanisms (dual PDF writers from typst watch + exportPdf=onSave racing, and a preview toggle/registry desync that can orphan a running preview and spawn a duplicate); documents the deprecated vim.lsp.buf.execute_command pin API and a pin-state buffer-local vs. LSP-client-scoped drift bug; recommends a shared lua/neotex/util/typst.lua helper, content-aware main-file detection, and dropping the redundant <leader>lw verb.
